Hi Alex / Samantha —

Thanks again for your time this morning. Quick recap + the next steps we discussed so your security/compliance team can begin intake: 

Call highlights:
- Redwood demoed hosted + dedicated deployment options and our audit/observability hooks.
- You asked about SOC 2 coverage, HIPAA posture for PHI, GDPR dataflows, and our incident notification timelines.
- You requested an initial pack of artifacts and a vendor questionnaire to keep procurement moving.

Action items (proposed timelines):
1) Mediconnect to confirm current SOC 2 status and provide any redacted evidence (control IDs or summary). Target: by Tue 2026-06-16 EOD.
2) We will provide an IR playbook template and our incident notification windows (initial notice, full report, remediation timeline). Target: sent today.
3) Mediconnect to complete the attached vendor security questionnaire and indicate any regulatory constraints (HIPAA BAAs, data residency). Target: by Thu 2026-06-18.
4) Schedule a 30-minute follow-up with security to review gaps and outstanding evidence on Thu 2026-06-18 at 10:00 PT (proposed).

To help speed review I attached a short SOC 2 summary template and a blank vendor questionnaire — feel free to return a redacted SOC 2 summary and the completed spreadsheet. If there are specific docs you need from us (COOP/DR diagrams, insurance cert, BAA template), list them in your reply and we'll prioritize.

Attachments: [SOC2_summary_redacted.pdf (PDF, stub)]

Thanks —

Jasmine —

Appreciate the clear recap. Quick answers and next steps from our side:

- SOC 2: We maintain SOC 2 Type II for our platform; I can share a redacted summary (control map + reporting period). Attaching the summary now.
- HIPAA: We are a covered entity; we will need a BAA. Please send your standard BAA and any relevant notes about how Redwood handles PHI in hosted vs. dedicated.
- GDPR: Data residency is primarily US for our workloads; we may need EU processing addenda for a subset of customers later.
- Incident response / notification: Please send your standard timelines and the IR playbook template.

Attachments: [SOC2_Mediconnect_summary_redacted.pdf (PDF, stub)]

We will start filling the vendor questionnaire but have a few internal reviewers. Targeting completion by Thu 6/18 as you asked. Also, who is the Redwood IR contact for urgent escalations (phone/empowered contact)?

Thanks Alex — got the redacted SOC 2 summary.

Please find attached our IR playbook template and a very short extract that summarizes notification windows below so your team can map against your internal SLAs: 

- Initial Acknowledgement: within 1 business hour of confirmed incident (email + pager).
- Incident Triage & Scope: 4 business hours.
- Customer Impact Notification: within 24 hours of confirmed customer-affecting incident (initial notice).
- Root Cause & Remediation Plan: substantive update within 72 hours; final report within 14 days unless extended by mutual agreement.

We can provide a signed BAA template (our legal team prefers to start from our standard and review counterpoints). I've attached: IR_playbook_template.docx and a short SOC2-extraction template for the procurement team.

Proposed schedule to keep momentum:
- Tue 6/16: inventory call if you want us to walk procurement through our SOC2 extract (30 min).
- Thu 6/18 10:00 PT: follow-up with security to review questionnaire + outstanding artifacts.

Attachments: [IR_playbook_template.docx (DOCX, stub)]

Would you confirm whether Mediconnect needs a connectivity diagram or proof of COOP/DR execution (we have a DR diagram and a one-page BCP summary we can share)?

Best,
Jasmine
Senior Account Executive
